## USB Drive Inventory Collector 4.2.3

This patch aligns Capacity Unit with Capacity in Manual Drive Entry and evens the spacing of the Workbook Setup buttons. It also keeps the Type label aligned when editing a recorded drive, shows paused scanning in red, and opens Version Information without selecting its text.

Terminal now starts only when enabled beside its tab. The GUI and Terminal share a pause state. Recorded Drives has fixed column widths, darker headers, and display-only row numbers; editing a sorted row opens the matching workbook record.
